summary: Tested all features from review_request: chat bookings, Google reviews graceful degrade, follow-up scheduling + unsubscribe flow, blog post, local service page, and end-to-end chat booking UI flow. 8/8 backend pytest cases passed and frontend booking flow works end-to-end. One UX issue found: the ExitIntentModal (Radix Dialog overlay, z-50) intercepts pointer events on the chat widget when both are open, even though the chat panel is visually above (z-9990).

ui_bugs.issue: Once ExitIntentModal opens on the homepage, its Radix DialogOverlay (z-50, fixed inset-0, bg-black/80) blocks all pointer events on the ChatWidget panel (z-[9990]) — clicks on chat-widget-send, chat-open-booking, chat-booking-* become unresponsive even though the chat is visually on top. The chat must either pause/dismiss the exit-intent while open, or the chat panel must use a portal with pointer-events:auto above the overlay.

issues: CTA at the bottom uses <Button onClick={navigate('/microcement-installers-new-orleans')}> instead of a real <a href> — bad for SEO, accessibility, middle-click open-in-new-tab, and screen readers. Should be an anchor styled as a button. Functionally renders and navigates fine.

passed_tests: POST /api/bookings success: 200, status=confirmed, booking + lead (source=chat_booking) persisted
POST /api/bookings 400 on missing fields with exact detail message
GET /api/google-reviews graceful degrade: 200 with rating=null, reviews=[] (no API key)
POST /api/leads/quick schedules 3 followup rows in db.lead_followups, all status=pending, send_at gaps ~+24h/+72h/+120h
Unsubscribe flow: real token marks rows skipped_unsubscribed, inserts db.lead_unsubscribes, and blocks new followups for the same email
GET /microcement-installers-new-orleans renders correct H1 'Microcement installers in New Orleans — one craftsman, real portfolio, fast quote.' and GoogleReviews widget self-hides (no rating)
GET /blog/how-to-choose-microcement-installer-new-orleans renders correct H1 + all 6 numbered questions + CTA navigating to /microcement-installers-new-orleans

End-to-end chat booking on /microcement-installers-new-orleans: opened chat, sent 2 messages, clicked chat-open-booking (7 day buttons present), selected day + morning, entered name+phone, submitted, chat-booking-success visible, assistant confirmation message 'You're booked for ...' appended
action_items: FIX: ExitIntentModal vs ChatWidget pointer-event conflict — when chat is open, exit-intent overlay (Radix Dialog) intercepts clicks even though chat is visually on top. Options: (a) suppress exit-intent fire while chat is open, (b) auto-close exit-intent when chat is open, or (c) use Dialog `modal=false` on exit-intent so it doesn't trap pointer events.
POLISH: Convert blog post CTA from Button+navigate to a real <a href> styled as a button (SEO/a11y).
critical_code_review_comments: ExitIntentModal modality vs ChatWidget z-index — pointer events trap is a real UX bug, will affect real users on homepage who open chat after mouse leaves toward top

BookingPanel POST blocks the form until response (15s timeout). Booking notifications (SMS, autoreply, customer email, followups) are correctly fired via asyncio.create_task so they don't block the booking response. Good.

Booking confirmation assistant message has a stray double period: 'Ryan will confirm via text..' — `replace('You're booked for ', '')` returns `<date> <time>. Ryan will confirm via text.` then ChatWidget prepends `You're booked for ` and appends another period via ` slot.\n` — minor cosmetic.

followup_service.schedule_followups idempotency: it does NOT check for existing pending rows for the same lead_id, so a duplicate /api/leads/quick call before unsubscribe would create 6 followup rows. Low impact today but worth a unique index on (lead_id, step).
google_reviews.get_reviews caches even the empty 'no api key' shape? Actually no — it only writes cache when `raw` is non-None. Good — when key is added later, the next call will fetch live.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (booking flow works on /microcement-installers-new-orleans; homepage chat flow blocked by exit-intent overlay)

test_credentials: Not applicable for these features (no auth required).
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_-prefixed booking + lead rows and 6 followup rows (2 lead emails) via the public API during tests. Safe to leave; not in production DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_bookings_reviews_followups.py is comprehensive and reusable. The single open issue is the ExitIntentModal Radix overlay trapping pointer events over the open ChatWidget on homepage. Booking flow verified on /microcement-installers-new-orleans, but not on / (homepage) due to that overlay conflict.
rca of the issue: Radix Dialog uses DialogOverlay (fixed inset-0 z-50) + sets aria-hidden on the rest of the tree when modal. Even though ChatWidget panel is z-[9990] visually above, Radix's overlay grabs pointer-events when the dialog is open as it's modal=true by default. This is why clicks on chat-widget-send / chat-open-booking time out with 'DialogOverlay intercepts pointer events'. Fix: pass modal={false} to the ExitIntent dialog, OR close exit-intent when chat is open, OR don't trigger exit-intent while chat is open.
